title: Duckie's Revenge Arcade

services.name: Party Room Rental + Arcade Package
services.desc: Includes a 2 hour party room reservation and 5 arcade day passes. Additional guests who want to play can purchase a day pass for $12. Food and drinks are available for purchase from our menu, including hot dogs, nachos, pretzels, and other snack favorites. The party room comfortably seats 16 guests. If your group is larger, extra guests are welcome to join the fun, but they may need to stand. You’re welcome to bring a cake or dessert to celebrate, and there is a wall available if you’d like to decorate and personalize the space.
